projects.name: Grafana-Monitoring-Stack
projects.description: Configured a Grafana monitoring stack on AWS EC2 to achieve real-time observability.
outcomes: Enabled proactive tracking of CPU, memory, and I/O bottlenecks.
Saved 30% in costs compared to paid monitoring tools.

projects.name: Serverless Deployment on AWS
projects.description: Implemented a fully serverless application using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and S3 to build a scalable and cost-efficient architecture.
outcomes: Reduced troubleshooting time by 70% using CloudWatch monitoring.
Saved more than $2,500 annually in hosting and scaling costs.
